entities.name: Online Bookstore
entities.description: A cloud-native e-commerce platform designed to provide catalog browsing, secure multi-currency checkout, recommendations, and reviews for physical and electronic books.

entities.name: Book Buyer (Customer)
entities.description: End-user who browses the catalog, makes purchases, and leaves reviews.

entities.name: Registered Reviewer
entities.description: User who writes and manages reviews for books.

entities.name: Store Administrator
entities.description: User who manages store operations and administration.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: Stripe/PayPal used for secure multi-currency checkout.

entities.name: Third-Party Shipping APIs
entities.description: FedEx/UPS used for handling shipping logistics.

entities.name: Identity Provider
entities.description: Auth0/AWS Cognito used for OAuth2/OIDC authentication and JWT scopes.

entities.name: Notification Provider
entities.description: SendGrid/Twilio used for sending user notifications.

entities.name: Tax Calculation Service
entities.description: Avalara used for calculating order taxes.

entities.name: AWS CloudFront
entities.description: CDN for global content caching and edge acceleration.
